wizard.title: Add Modbus device
wizard.subtitle: Connect a Modbus TCP gateway and map its registers to a device

errors.reversed: The end of the range must not be lower than its start
errors.tooMany: A range can hold at most 256 points
errors.zeroNotAllowed: Addresses start at 1 in this notation
errors.modiconMixed: Both ends of a range must be in the same register table

errors.connection: The connection was refused: check the port and that the Modbus TCP server is switched on
errors.timeout: No answer: check the IP address, the unit ID and the framing
errors.busy: Another probe to this endpoint is still running; try again in a moment
errors.illegalFunction: The device does not support this function for the register type
errors.illegalAddress: The device is reachable but does not have this address; try another address
errors.gatewayUnreachable: The gateway could not reach the unit; check the unit ID and the serial line
errors.unavailable: The endpoint is waiting to reconnect after a failure; try again shortly

probe.title: Test connection
probe.description: Reads a few values to check that the device answers. Nothing is written or saved.

select.title: Endpoint
select.manage: Manage endpoints (opens in a new tab)
select.loadFailed: Failed to load the Modbus endpoints.

unitId.title: Unit ID
unitId.hint: Modbus unit (slave) ID, 0-255. Most TCP devices use 1.
unitId.broadcastWarning: Unit ID 0 is the broadcast address on RTU lines: devices do not answer it, so reads will time out.

template.none: No device templates are available; start with an empty device.
template.loadFailed: Failed to load the device templates.
template.applyFailed: Failed to apply the device template.
template.fileErrors: Some template files could not be loaded

points.customNotice: The points differ from the template, so the device will be created as a custom device.
points.empty: No points yet. Add the addresses to read or switch above.
points.needsRead: Add at least one point with a read binding: a device needs something to read.

errors.registerType: This capability cannot use that register table
errors.writeRegisterType: A write binding must use a coil or holding register
errors.tooManyTotal: A device can have at most {max} points ({free} more can be added)

testWrite.title: Test write: {name}
testWrite.description: Writes the value to the real device once. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
testWrite.confirm: Write {value} to {device}? Unit ID {unit}, {registerType}, stored (PDU) address {address} (shown as {shown}). This changes the real device.

category.title: Category
category.hint: Devices with a writable point are usually switchers; read-only devices are input controllers.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollInterval.hint: How often the device is read, at least 100 ms.
pollInterval.buttonHint: Button inputs are short pulses: a poll interval of 100-250 ms catches them.

review.failed: The device could not be created

endpoints.subtitle: Gateways the Modbus devices are polled through
